while(T){
    hpq = sample(2:8,3)*sample(c(-1,1),3,T)
    h = hpq[1]
    p = min(hpq[2:3])
    q = max(hpq[2:3])
    b = p+q+2*h
    c = p*q+b*h-h^2
    if(abs(b)>1 && abs(c)>0){
        break
    }
}


pqs = list(c(p,q))


if(b^2+4*h^2+4*b*h-4*c>0){
    p2 = round((b - sqrt(b^2+4*h^2+4*b*h-4*c))/2)
    q2 = round((b + sqrt(b^2+4*h^2+4*b*h-4*c))/2)
    pq2 = sort(c(p2,q2))
} else {
    pq2 = sort(sample(2:9,2)*sample(c(-1,1),2,T))
    p2 = min(pq2)
    q2 = max(pq2)
}
pqs[[length(pqs)+1]] = pq2

if(b^2-4*h^2+4*b*h-4*c>0){
    p3 = round((b - sqrt(b^2-4*h^2+4*b*h-4*c))/2)
    q3 = round((b + sqrt(b^2-4*h^2+4*b*h-4*c))/2)
    pq3 = sort(c(p3,q3))
} else {
    pq3 = sample(2:9,2)*sample(c(-1,1),2,T)
    p3 = min(pq3)
    q3 = max(pq3)
}
pqs[[length(pqs)+1]] = pq3
pqs = unique(pqs)

if((2*h-b)^2-4*h^2-4*b*h-4*c>0){
    p4 = round((-(2*h-b) - sqrt((2*h-b)^2-4*h^2-4*b*h-4*c))/2)
    q4 = round((-(2*h-b) + sqrt((2*h-b)^2-4*h^2-4*b*h-4*c))/2)
    pq4 = sort(c(p4,q4))
} else {
    pq4 = sample(2:9,2)*sample(c(-1,1),2,T)
    p4 = min(pq4)
    q4 = max(pq4)
}
pqs[[length(pqs)+1]] = pq4
pqs = unique(pqs)

while(length(pqs)<4){

    p5 = min(pq5)

    pqs = unique(pqs)
}

pqs = list()

for(i in 1:length(fckit)){

}

}



if(h<0){

f1 = paste0("(x+",-h,")^2+",b,"(x+",-h,")+",c,collapse="")
f1 = gsub("+-","-",f1,fixed=T)

f2 = paste0("(x+",q,")(x+",p,")")

Question
========

Let function $f$ represent a standard-form quadratic polynomial shifted horizontally `r abs(h)` units to the `r w1`.

$$f(x)=`r f1`$$

Express function $f$ in factored form.

Answerlist
--------

`r al`


Solution
========

Given: $$`r f1`$$

[Expand the squared binomial](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Binomial_theorem). 


$$`r f3`$$

Distribute.


$$`r f4`$$

Combine like terms.

$$`r f5`$$

Factor.

$$`r f2`$$
